title: Annotate a plot with icons at fixed positions — annotation_icon
text: annotation_icon() draws one icons fixed (x, y) positions, icon analogue ggplot2::annotation_custom() / ggplot2::annotation_raster(): single call adds icons directly, without data frame aes() mapping. title: ggicons: Icon Geometries for 'ggplot2' — ggicons-package
text: Provides icon geometries 'ggplot2', using vector icon sets 'icons' package. geom_icon() draws icon per row place point, styled usual colour, size, alpha angle aesthetics. Icon data passed straight scale_icon_identity(), mapped discrete values scale_icon_manual(). Icons also appear legend keys, fixed-position markers annotation_icon(), axis, strip legend labels via element_icon() theme element.

title: ggicons (development version)
text: Initial CRAN submission. Added geom_icon(), =geom draws icon per row icon aesthetic, styled colour/fill, size, alpha angle. icon aesthetic takes icon vector icons package directly (e.g. icons::fontawesome$solid$rocket). Added draw_key_icon(), default geom_icon() legend key glyph. Added scale_icon_identity() scale_icon_manual(), plus scale_type.icon() method aes(icon = ...) picks sensible scale. Added annotation_icon(), drawing one icons fixed positions, recycled way annotate() recycles arguments. Added element_icon(), theme() element (parallel element_text()) axis.text/strip.text/legend.text draws label matching name supplied icons lookup icon, falling back ordinary text everything else. first cut trickiest part package’s design, ships known rough edges (documented full ?element_icon): lookup must named list() individual icons rather named icon vector (icons package’s vector type can’t carry element names ); icon sizing follows simple size (points) convention rather matching text x-height exactly; hjust/vjust/margin nudging apply text-fallback side, icons (always centred label position).
